description: Wasserschutzgebiete is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltkarten.lung-mv.de. Pursuant to Paragraph 51(1) of the Wasserhaushaltsgesetz (WHG), the Land Government may, by means of an ordinance, establish water protection areas in order to protect water bodies from adverse effects in the interest of public water supply, so-called drinking water protection areas. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2026-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
